reason: A DSH Cordis plugin that converts source text or conversation traces into an evidence-linked knowledge graph, with visualization, validation, review, persistence, incremental updates, and export.

summaries.zh: 将资料正文或会话轨迹用 AI 拆分为可与原文双向定位的知识图，并提供可视化、验证、审核、持久化和导出功能。
summaries.en: An AI-powered DSH Cordis plugin that turns source text or conversation traces into knowledge graphs linked bidirectionally to their evidence, with visualization, validation, review, persistence, and export.

capabilities: uses configured LLM providers to extract and review knowledge graphs
stores source text, graph data, checkpoints, and review records in SQLite
queries external evidence sources such as Wikipedia for fact checking
exports graph data as JSON, CSV, and PNG
modifies graph nodes, relationships, and audit records through review workflows
